title: Well designed kit for children
text: I bought this for my granddaughter. Each lesson is packaged separately inside so that all the needed parts are together and the child isn’t overwhelmed with tempting pieces from another activity. I bought the the 6-8 for a five year old which she has thoroughly enjoyed. She already cannot wait for the next box to arrive, and is very proud of her learned knowledge and creations from this first box! Score for Grandma-I highly recommend!
label: positive
